newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Cetes rate closes up but off earlier highs.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Cetes rate closes up but off earlier highs.

text.p: Mexican overnight Cetes rates ended up 20 basis points at 20.50 percent on Monday after zigzagging through the session on what dealers said was speculation.
"Rates were so high they triggered demand for paper and then the peso firmed up, too," a trader said.

Overnight rates reached as high as 22.70 percent in early trade under pressure from uncertainty generated by the death of veteran labor leader Fidel Velazquez in the run-up to midterm elections on July 6.
